behaviors.description: Update from an independent sideload source when new remote payloads are unavailable.
behaviors.preconditions: Signed A deployment, independently signed B with different executable bytes, and a B app-only sideload repository.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary update attempts a blocked payload download and preserves A; the sideload option reaches exact B without requesting remote payloads, while retaining the runtime.

mappings.rationale: Independent changed payloads and a failing no-sideload control prevent a cached or metadata-only update from satisfying the assertion.

surface_assertions.rationale: The local source permits the exact signed B update without HTTP payload downloads after ordinary update fails.
